faq: Who is a member of the Society?
Every Accounting and Finance major and minor at Deree is a member automatically. Signing up adds you to our list so you hear about events and limited places.
Can students from other majors join?
Yes. Students from any major can join as associate members and take part in our events.
Why do I need my ACG email?
The Society is for current Deree students, and your ACG email is how we confirm that. Sign-ups with personal emails are not accepted.
How will I hear about events?

After signing up you get the link to the members' WhatsApp group. Once we approve your request, you'll see announcements, sign-ups and members-only codes there first. Events are also posted on Instagram and LinkedIn.

faq: Who can apply?
Any current Deree student. Accounting and Finance majors and minors are members automatically, and students from every other major are welcome as associate members.
Do I need experience?
No. We look for curiosity and commitment. For analyst roles, the form includes a short task: pick one company listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and tell us in about 100 words why it's interesting.
Can I apply for more than one role?
Yes. Rank up to three roles in order of preference on the form.
Is it paid?
No. These are volunteer student roles. What you get is experience, a title, published work and priority access to Society opportunities.
What happens during exams?
Weekly work pauses during midterm and final exam weeks. We plan around them from the start.
What happens after I apply?
We contact shortlisted applicants for a short chat between 2 and 4 December. The Governing Body decides, and everyone hears back by 8 December.
